content: When we think we know, we cease to learn. The beginning of wisdom is the recognition of our deep ignorance.
author: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
explanation: Arrogant certainty seals the mind against discovery. The greatest philosophers and scientists remain perpetual students in awe of cosmic mystery.
practicalInsight: Adopt a beginner's mind in your meetings and study today. Ask genuine questions instead of trying to appear all-knowing.
reflectionPrompt: What subject do I presume I fully understand where I actually have much more to learn?
